description: This file declares functions related to JIT graph transformations and optimizations for mobile deployment in PyTorch, such as convolution transformations, pre-packing insertions, and module optimizations.

methods.name: transformConv1dToConv2d
methods.description: Transforms Conv1d operations in a graph or module to Conv2d.

methods.name: insertPrePackedOps
methods.description: Inserts pre-packed operations into a graph or module.

methods.name: fusePrePackedLinearConvWithClamp
methods.description: Fuses pre-packed linear and convolution operations with clamp operations within a module.

methods.name: FoldPrePackingOps
methods.description: Folds pre-packing operations within a module to optimize graph execution.

methods.name: optimizeForMobile
methods.description: Performs optimization passes on a script::Module to prepare it for mobile deployment, with optional blocklist and method preservation.
